title: Bounded cleanup time
responsibility: Creates a shared deadline that ends waits and supplies fallback answers when cleanup work fails or takes too long.

inputs.name: cleanupDeadline.milliseconds
inputs.description: Milliseconds before the deadline aborts, which ends pending within() calls with their fallbacks and cuts pause() short; the timer starts as soon as cleanupDeadline is called and is unreferenced, so it does not keep the process alive. The value is not checked, and Node's timers set any value outside the range 1 to 2147483647, NaN included, to 1, so such a deadline aborts after 1 ms.

outputs.name: cleanupDeadline
outputs.description: A deadline object whose signal aborts when its time runs out, and cancel() aborts it immediately; expired() returns true once the signal has aborted, within(work, fallback) resolves to the work's answer or to fallback when the work rejects or the signal aborts first, and pause(ms) resolves after ms or when the signal aborts. The deadline only stops waiting, so work that ignores the signal keeps running after within() returns fallback, and once the signal has aborted, within() returns fallback at once.
